acceptanceCriteria: Callers can pass requirement IDs per selector (flag or mapping file) for Ruby and JS selected examples.
The receipt echoes each ID beside the example outcome, marked caller-asserted, never inferred.
Spec requirements and tests cover malformed and unknown selectors.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1292 (opened 2026-10-20). Feature request; not yet specified. Consumers map tests to external requirement or row identifiers. For JS tests this is done via titles/steps; for selected Ruby examples there is no channel, so the mapping lives outside the receipt and must be re-validated separately. Ask: let the caller pass requirement IDs per selector (e.g. `--select path[id]=REQ-1,REQ-2` or a mapping file). Echo them in the receipt next to each example's outcome, so a receipt alone shows which requirement each passing example witnessed. Mark them caller-asserted, not inferred. See beamfall/corvint#1292 for the full text.
title: Carry caller-supplied requirement IDs through selected-example receipts (issue #1292)
